session_3.text: I want to make sure that my Excel files have clear headers. What’s the best practice for naming the first header row?
session_3.speaker: Bob

session_3.text: It’s best to use a short, descriptive name for each column. For your contact list, you should use 'name' as the first header in the Excel file, since you’re listing people’s names.
session_3.speaker: AI

session_3.text: So, I should make sure the first row just says 'name'?

session_3.text: Exactly! The first row should be 'name', so anyone who checks your file knows what data follows.

session_3.text: Thanks, I'll update the file later. What other tips do you have for making spreadsheets easy to read?

session_3.text: Use clear headers, avoid clutter, and keep only necessary columns. Use consistent formatting and freeze the header row for easier navigation.
